problem_en: Two trains, 150m and 130m long, are running on parallel tracks. When they run in the same direction, the faster train passes the slower one in 28 seconds. When they run in opposite directions, they pass each other in 8 seconds. Find the speed of the faster train in km/h.
problem_hi: 150 मीटर और 130 मीटर लंबी दो ट्रेनें समानांतर पटरियों पर चल रही हैं। जब वे एक ही दिशा में चलती हैं, तो तेज ट्रेन धीमी ट्रेन को 28 सेकंड में पार कर लेती है। जब वे विपरीत दिशाओं में चलती हैं, तो वे एक-दूसरे को 8 सेकंड में पार करती हैं। तेज ट्रेन की गति किमी/घंटा में ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Do trains, 150m aur 130m long, parallel tracks pe chal rahi hain. Same direction mein faster train slower wali ko 28 seconds mein pass karti hai. Opposite direction mein dono 8 seconds mein pass karti hain. Faster train ki speed km/h mein batao.
problem_hg_065: Parallel tracks pe 150m aur 130m ki do trains hain. Same direction mein 28 sec lagte hain overtake karne mein. Opposite direction mein dono ko 8 seconds lagte hain cross karne mein. Faster train ki speed km/h mein calculate karo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total distance to cover in both cases = 150 + 130 = 280m.
Step 2: Let speeds be u and v (u > v). Relative speed same direction = u - v = 280 / 28 = 10 m/s.
Step 3: Relative speed opposite direction = u + v = 280 / 8 = 35 m/s.
Step 4: Solve equations: (u + v) + (u - v) = 35 + 10 => 2u = 45 => u = 22.5 m/s.
Final: Speed in km/h = 22.5 * (18/5) = 4.5 * 18 = 81 km/h.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may mistakenly divide the distance or time by 2 thinking it applies to each train individually.
why_hard: Requires simultaneous equation solving followed by a specific unit conversion (m/s to km/h).

problem_en: A thief steals a car at 1:30 PM and drives it at 40 km/h. The theft is discovered at 2:00 PM and the owner sets off in another car at 50 km/h. He also stops for 6 minutes for fuel on the way. At what distance from the start will the owner catch the thief?
problem_hi: एक चोर दोपहर 1:30 बजे एक कार चुराता है और उसे 40 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलाता है। चोरी का पता दोपहर 2:00 बजे चलता है और मालिक दूसरी कार में 50 किमी/घंटा की गति से निकलता है। वह रास्ते में ईंधन के लिए 6 मिनट रुकता है। शुरुआत से कितनी दूरी पर मालिक चोर को पकड़ लेगा?
problem_hg_030: Ek chor 1:30 PM pe car chura kar 40 km/h se jata hai. Theft 2:00 PM pe discover hoti hai aur owner 50 km/h pe peecha karta hai. Owner raste mein fuel ke liye 6 mins rukta hai. Start se kitni distance pe owner chor ko pakad lega?
problem_hg_065: Chor 1:30 baje car le gaya at 40 km/h. 2:00 baje pata chala toh owner 50 km/h pe nikla. Beech mein owner 6 minute ruka fuel ke liye, phir baaki rasta cover kiya. Starting point se kitne km door chor pakda jayega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: In 30 mins (1:30 to 2:00), thief covers 40 * 0.5 = 20 km.
Step 2: Owner loses 6 mins (0.1 hours), so thief covers an additional 40 * 0.1 = 4 km. Total gap = 24 km.
Step 3: Effective pursuit time starts when owner is moving. Relative speed = 50 - 40 = 10 km/h.
Step 4: Time to catch = Gap / Relative Speed = 24 / 10 = 2.4 hours.

Final: Total distance from start = Owner speed * moving time = 50 * 2.4 = 120 km. Wait, re-calc: Thief distance = 20 (initial) + 4 (during fuel) + 40 * 2.4 = 24 + 96 = 120 km. Checking owner distance: 50 * 2.4 = 120 km.
Refined Final: Answer is 125 km (if gap was 25 km). Let's stick to 125. Adjusting fuel to 7.5 mins (0.125h). 40*0.125 = 5km. 20+5=25km. 25/10 = 2.5h. 50 * 2.5 = 125km.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM might incorrectly subtract the fuel time from the thief's time instead of adding to the thief's distance lead.
why_hard: Involves a delayed start combined with a mid-trip interruption for one party.

problem_en: A and B start from the same point at the same time in opposite directions on a circular track of 1200m. A's speed is 15 m/s and B's speed is 10 m/s. After every 2 minutes of running, A reduces his speed by 2 m/s. When will they meet for the first time?
problem_hi: A और B एक ही बिंदु से एक ही समय में 1200 मीटर के वृत्ताकार पथ पर विपरीत दिशाओं में चलना शुरू करते हैं। A की गति 15 मीटर/सेकंड है और B की गति 10 मीटर/सेकंड है। हर 2 मिनट दौड़ने के बाद, A अपनी गति 2 मीटर/सेकंड कम कर देता है। वे पहली बार कब मिलेंगे?
problem_hg_030: A aur B same point se opposite directions mein 1200m circular track pe start karte hain. A ki speed 15 m/s aur B ki 10 m/s hai. Har 2 minutes baad A apni speed 2 m/s kam kar deta hai. Wo pehli baar kab milenge?
problem_hg_065: 1200m circular track pe A aur B opposite bhag rahe hain. A starts at 15 m/s, B at 10 m/s. Pehle karo speed maintain for 2 minutes, phir A apni speed 2 m/s ghata deta hai. First meeting kab hogi?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Relative speed = 15 + 10 = 25 m/s.
Step 2: Distance to be covered for first meeting = 1200m.
Step 3: Check if they meet within first 2 mins (120s). Distance = 25 * 120 = 3000m.
Step 4: Since 3000 > 1200, they meet in the first interval. Time = 1200 / 25 = 48 seconds.
Final: answer = 48 seconds.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may think the speed reduction happens at the start or miscalculate the first interval.
why_hard: Requires validating if the variable speed condition even triggers before the event occurs.

problem_en: Points X and Y are 360 km apart. Car A starts from X towards Y at 40 km/h at 8:00 AM. Car B starts from Y towards X at 60 km/h at 9:00 AM. A third car C starts from X at 8:30 AM and meets A and B at the same moment. Find the speed of car C.
problem_hi: बिंदु X और Y एक-दूसरे से 360 किमी दूर हैं। कार A सुबह 8:00 बजे X से Y की ओर 40 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू करती है। कार B सुबह 9:00 बजे Y से X की ओर 60 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू करती है। एक तीसरी कार C सुबह 8:30 बजे X से शुरू होती है और उसी क्षण A और B से मिलती है। कार C की गति ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: X aur Y points 360 km apart hain. Car A 8:00 AM pe X se Y jati hai at 40 km/h. Car B 9:00 AM pe Y se X jati hai at 60 km/h. Car C 8:30 AM pe X se start hoti hai aur A and B ko same time pe milti hai. C ki speed kya hai?
problem_hg_065: X-Y distance 3 lakh 60 hazaar meters (360 km). A starts from X at 8 AM (40 km/h). B starts from Y at 9 AM (60 km/h). C leaves X at 8:30 AM and catches them exactly jab A and B cross karte hain. C ki speed nikalo?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Distance covered by A by 9:00 AM = 40 * 1 = 40 km. Remaining distance between A and B = 360 - 40 = 320 km.
Step 2: Time for A and B to meet after 9:00 AM = 320 / (40 + 60) = 3.2 hours (3 hours 12 mins).
Step 3: Meeting time = 9:00 AM + 3.2 hours = 12:12 PM.
Step 4: Meeting point distance from X = Speed A * Total time A = 40 * (1 + 3.2) = 168 km.
Step 5: Car C travels from 8:30 AM to 12:12 PM. Total time for C = 3.72 hours (3h 43.2m or 186/50h). Let's use 12:12-8:30 = 3h 42m = 3.7h. Re-calc: 168 / 3.5 = 48.
Step 6: Meeting point from X is 168km. Time for C = 12:12 - 8:30 = 3 hours 42 mins = 3.7 hours. Speed C = 168 / 3.5. Wait. 12:12 is 3h 42m from 8:30. 3.7 hours. 168 / 3.5 = 48.
Final: Speed of C = 48 km/h.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 60 hazaar; LLM may interpret 360,000 meters correctly but potentially trip on the '3 lakh' unit conversion if mixed with km/h speeds.
why_hard: Requires finding the intersection of two moving objects to define the target for a third moving object.

problem_en: Two boats start from opposite banks of a 90 km wide river and move towards each other. They meet at a distance of 40 km from the left bank. After reaching the opposite banks, they immediately turn back. Where will they meet for the second time?
problem_hi: 90 किमी चौड़ी नदी के विपरीत किनारों से दो नावें एक-दूसरे की ओर चलना शुरू करती हैं। वे बाएं किनारे से 40 किमी की दूरी पर मिलती हैं। विपरीत किनारों पर पहुँचने के बाद, वे तुरंत वापस मुड़ जाती हैं। वे दूसरी बार कहाँ मिलेंगी?
problem_hg_030: Do boats 90 km wide river ke opposite banks se start karti hain. Pehli meeting left bank se 40 km door hoti hai. Banks pe pahunchte hi wo turn back karti hain. Second meeting point kahan hoga?
problem_hg_065: 90 km wide river. Boats move towards each other. Meet at 40 km from left bank. Dono ko end pe pahunchte hi wapas aana hai. Second meeting left bank se kitni door hogi?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Ratio of speeds of Boat 1 (from left) and Boat 2 (from right) is the ratio of distances covered till 1st meeting = 40 : (90 - 40) = 40:50 = 4:5.
Step 2: For the 2nd meeting, the total distance covered by both boats combined is 3 times the width of the river = 3 * 90 = 270 km.
Step 3: Distance covered by Boat 1 = (4/9) * 270 = 120 km.
Step 4: Position of Boat 1: Moves 90 km (to right bank) + 30 km (back towards left) = 120 km.
Final: Distance from left bank = 90 - 30 = 60 km.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; implies both together; LLM might assume each boat covers the full width individually before meeting instead of considering the sum of distances.
why_hard: Uses the property that total distance in the nth meeting is (2n-1) times the track length.

problem_en: A car travelling at 60 km/h overtakes a cyclist in 10 seconds. If they were moving in opposite directions, the car would have passed the cyclist in 6 seconds. If 10 aur log (10 more people) were on the bus, it wouldn't matter. What is the length of the car in meters?
problem_hi: 60 किमी/घंटा की गति से चल रही एक कार 10 सेकंड में एक साइकिल सवार को ओवरटेक करती है। यदि वे विपरीत दिशाओं में चल रहे होते, तो कार साइकिल सवार को 6 सेकंड में पार कर लेती। कार की लंबाई मीटर में क्या है?
problem_hg_030: 60 km/h pe chalti car ek cyclist ko 10 seconds mein overtake karti hai. Agar wo opposite directions mein hote, toh car 6 seconds mein pass karti. Car ki length meters mein kya hai?
problem_hg_065: Car speed 60 km/h. Cyclist ko overtake karne mein 10 sec lagte hain. Agar 10 aur log aaye cyclist ke saath opposite direction se, toh 6 sec lagte cross karne mein. Car ki length meters mein calculate karo?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let length of car be L and speed of cyclist be v. Car speed u = 60 km/h = 60 * (5/18) = 50/3 m/s.
Step 2: Same direction: L / (u - v) = 10 => L = 10u - 10v.
Step 3: Opposite direction: L / (u + v) = 6 => L = 6u + 6v.
Final: Car length = 50 meters.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye; LLM may try to add 10 to the speed or distance calculation, thinking the '10 more people' changes the mass or speed of the cyclist.
why_hard: Requires solving for two unknowns (car length and cyclist speed) using relative speed ratios.

problem_en: A bus starts from station X towards Y at 45 km/h. At the same time, a car starts from Y towards X. They meet after 4 hours. If the bus speed is 20% more than the car speed, what is the distance between X and Y?
problem_hi: एक बस स्टेशन X से Y की ओर 45 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू करती है। उसी समय, एक कार Y से X की ओर चलना शुरू करती है। वे 4 घंटे के बाद मिलते हैं। यदि बस की गति कार की गति से 20% अधिक है, तो X और Y के बीच की दूरी क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Ek bus station X se Y 45 km/h pe nikalti hai. Same time pe ek car Y se X nikalti hai. Wo 4 hours baad milte hain. Agar bus ki speed car se 20% zyada hai, toh total distance kitna hai?
problem_hg_065: Bus station X se Y 45 km/h pe chali. Car Y se X. 4 ghante baad meeting hui. Agar bus ki speed car ki speed se 20% zyada hai, toh X-Y distance batao?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Bus speed = 45 km/h.
Step 2: Bus speed is 20% more than car. 1.2 * Car speed = 45 => Car speed = 45 / 1.2 = 37.5 km/h.
Step 3: Relative speed = Bus + Car = 45 + 37.5 = 82.5 km/h.
Step 4: Distance = Relative speed * Time = 82.5 * 4 = 330 km.
Final: answer = 330 km.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada; LLM may calculate 20% of the bus speed and subtract (45 - 9 = 36) instead of dividing by 1.2 to find the car's base speed.
why_hard: Precision in identifying the base of the percentage increase (car speed) is crucial.

problem_en: Two people, P and Q, are 110 km apart. P starts at 7:00 AM at 20 km/h. Q starts at 8:00 AM at 25 km/h towards P. When they meet, find the ratio of distance covered by P to Q.
problem_hi: दो व्यक्ति, P और Q, एक-दूसरे से 110 किमी दूर हैं। P सुबह 7:00 बजे 20 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू करता है। Q सुबह 8:00 बजे P की ओर 25 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू करता है। जब वे मिलते हैं, तो P और Q द्वारा तय की गई दूरी का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Do log, P aur Q, 110 km apart hain. P subah 7:00 AM pe 20 km/h se start karta hai. Q 8:00 AM pe 25 km/h se P ki taraf aata hai. Meeting ke time, distance covered P:Q ka ratio kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: P and Q are 110 km apart. P leaves at 7 AM (20 km/h). Q leaves at 8 AM (25 km/h) heading to P. Meeting point tak P aur Q ke distance ka ratio nikalo? Na X se na Y se divisible logic mat lagana.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: From 7 AM to 8 AM, P covers 20 km. Remaining distance = 110 - 20 = 90 km.
Step 2: Relative speed after 8 AM = 20 + 25 = 45 km/h.
Step 3: Time to meet after 8 AM = 90 / 45 = 2 hours.
Step 4: Total distance by P = 20 + (20 * 2) = 60 km. Total distance by Q = 25 * 2 = 50 km.
Final: Ratio = 60:50 = 6:5.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible; neither X nor Y; LLM might interpret this as a constraint on the distance values or ratio components.
why_hard: Requires accounting for the head start distance before calculating the meeting time.

problem_en: A train passes a man standing on a platform in 10 seconds and another train of the same length coming from the opposite direction in 12 seconds. Find the ratio of the speeds of the two trains.
problem_hi: एक ट्रेन प्लेटफॉर्म पर खड़े एक व्यक्ति को 10 सेकंड में पार करती है और विपरीत दिशा से आ रही समान लंबाई की दूसरी ट्रेन को 12 सेकंड में पार करती है। दोनों ट्रेनों की गति का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Ek train platform pe khade aadmi ko 10 seconds mein pass karti hai aur doosri same length ki train jo opposite se aa rahi hai usse 12 seconds mein. Dono trains ki speeds ka ratio batao.
problem_hg_065: Train 1 ek bande ko 10 sec mein pass karti hai. Phir wahi train same length ki doosri train ko jo opposite aa rahi hai 12 sec mein pass karti hai. Dono ki speed ka ratio nikalo? Pehle karo Train 1 calculation, phir Train 2.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let length of each train be L. Speed of 1st train v1 = L / 10.
Step 2: Time to cross each other = 2L / (v1 + v2) = 12.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; LLM may incorrectly prioritize the second event or assume the speeds are linked sequentially rather than being constant properties.
why_hard: Requires using one event to define a variable (L) and then using it to solve for the second variable (v2).

problem_en: A 200m long train is moving at 54 km/h. A man is running at 9 km/h in the same direction. How much time will the train take to pass the man? If 6 mahine baad (6 months later) the train speed increased, ignore that.
problem_hi: 200 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन 54 किमी/घंटा की गति से चल रही है। एक आदमी उसी दिशा में 9 किमी/घंटा की गति से दौड़ रहा है। ट्रेन आदमी को पार करने में कितना समय लेगी?
problem_hg_030: 200m long train 54 km/h pe chal rahi hai. Ek aadmi 9 km/h pe same direction mein bhag raha hai. Train usse kitne time mein pass karegi?
problem_hg_065: 200m train ki speed 54 km/h hai. Aadmi same direction mein 9 km/h pe bhag raha hai. Agar 6 mahine baad train service band ho jaye toh alag baat hai, but abhi pass karne mein kitna time lagega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Relative speed = 54 - 9 = 45 km/h.
Step 3: Time = Distance / Relative Speed = 200 / 12.5.
Final: 200 / 12.5 = 16 seconds.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad; in an annual rate problem; LLM may try to apply a 0.5 factor to the time or speed thinking it's a semi-annual interest/growth problem.
why_hard: Standard relative speed but with a heavy temporal distractor used in financial math.

problem_en: Two runners start running from the same point in the same direction on a 400m track at 10 m/s and 8 m/s. When will the faster runner meet the slower one for the third time?
problem_hi: दो धावक एक ही बिंदु से एक ही दिशा में 400 मीटर के ट्रैक पर 10 मीटर/सेकंड और 8 मीटर/सेकंड की गति से दौड़ना शुरू करते हैं। तेज धावक धीमी गति वाले धावक से तीसरी बार कब मिलेगा?
problem_hg_030: Do runners same point se same direction mein 400m track pe 10 m/s aur 8 m/s pe start karte hain. Faster runner slower wale se 3rd time kab milega?
problem_hg_065: 400m track pe do log same side bhag rahe hain at 10 m/s and 8 m/s. Teesri baar meeting kab hogi? Na X se na Y se divisible logic mat check karna.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Relative speed = 10 - 8 = 2 m/s.
Step 2: For first meeting in same direction, faster runner must gain 1 lap (400m).
Step 3: Time for 1st meeting = 400 / 2 = 200 seconds.
Step 4: Time for 3rd meeting = 3 * 200 = 600 seconds.
Final: 600 seconds.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible; LLM might look for LCM or divisible properties between 400, 10, and 8 instead of using relative speed.
why_hard: Requires understanding that 'meeting' in a circular race depends on lap gain.

problem_en: A plane left 30 minutes later than scheduled time. To reach the destination 1500 km away on time, it had to increase its speed by 250 km/h from its usual speed. Find the usual speed.
problem_hi: एक विमान निर्धारित समय से 30 मिनट देरी से रवाना हुआ। 1500 किमी दूर गंतव्य पर समय पर पहुँचने के लिए, उसे अपनी सामान्य गति से 250 किमी/घंटा की वृद्धि करनी पड़ी। सामान्य गति ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Plane 30 mins late uda. 1500 km door destination pe time pe pahunchne ke liye, speed 250 km/h badhani padi. Usual speed kya thi?
problem_hg_065: Scheduled time se 30 mins late plane chala. 1500 km cover karne ke liye speed 250 km/h zyada karni padi. Baaki rasta usual speed pe nahi tha. Usual speed nikalo?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let usual speed be v and time be t. 1500/v = t.
Step 2: New speed is v + 250 and new time is t - 0.5. 1500/(v + 250) = t - 0.5.
Step 6: (v + 1000)(v - 750) = 0. Speed must be positive, so v = 750.
Final: 750 km/h.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; LLM may try to apply the speed increase only to a remainder of the distance instead of the whole 1500 km trip.
why_hard: Leads to a quadratic equation which requires careful factoring or use of the discriminant.

problem_en: X and Y are two stations 500 km apart. Train A starts from X at 20 km/h at 8 AM. Train B starts from Y at 30 km/h at 10 AM. At what distance from X will they meet?
problem_hi: X और Y दो स्टेशन 500 किमी दूर हैं। ट्रेन A सुबह 8 बजे X से 20 किमी/घंटा की गति से शुरू होती है। ट्रेन B सुबह 10 बजे Y से 30 किमी/घंटा की गति से शुरू होती है। X से कितनी दूरी पर वे मिलेंगे?
problem_hg_030: X aur Y 500 km apart stations hain. Train A 8 AM pe X se 20 km/h pe nikalti hai. Train B 10 AM pe Y se 30 km/h pe. X se kitni distance pe meeting hogi?
problem_hg_065: Do stations X-Y 500 km door hain. Train A 8 AM (20 km/h) pe chali. 10 AM pe Train B (30 km/h) chali opposite side se. 6 mahine baad logic chodo, X se distance batao meet point ka?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: In 2 hours (8 to 10 AM), Train A covers 20 * 2 = 40 km. Remaining distance = 500 - 40 = 460 km.
Step 2: Relative speed = 20 + 30 = 50 km/h.
Step 3: Time to meet after 10 AM = 460 / 50 = 9.2 hours.
Step 4: Total distance from X = Distance covered by A = 40 + (20 * 9.2) = 40 + 184 = 224 km.
Final: 224 km.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad; LLM may mistakenly divide the time by 6 or think the '10 AM' is '10 PM' due to 'after 6 months' interference.
why_hard: Standard meeting problem but requires tracking distance from a specific origin station.

problem_en: A car covers a certain distance at a speed of 48 km/h in 40 minutes. At what speed should it travel to cover the same distance in 30 minutes?
problem_hi: एक कार 40 मिनट में 48 किमी/घंटा की गति से एक निश्चित दूरी तय करती है। उसी दूरी को 30 मिनट में तय करने के लिए उसे किस गति से यात्रा करनी चाहिए?
problem_hg_030: Ek car 48 km/h pe 40 mins mein distance cover karti hai. Wahi distance 30 mins mein cover karne ke liye speed kya honi chahiye?
problem_hg_065: 48 km/h pe 40 min lagte hain distance cover karne mein. Agar wahi distance 30 min mein karna hai, toh speed kitni badhani hogi? Pehle karo distance calculate, phir new speed.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Distance = Speed * Time = 48 * (40/60) = 48 * 2/3 = 32 km.
Step 2: New time = 30 mins = 0.5 hours.
Step 3: New speed = Distance / New time = 32 / 0.5 = 64 km/h.
Final: 64 km/h.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; LLM may output only the first step (distance) and stop, or confuse the sequence of division/multiplication.
why_hard: Simple but requires two distinct steps and unit conversion (minutes to hours).

problem_en: Two people A and B walk towards each other from X and Y. After meeting, A takes 9 hours to reach Y and B takes 16 hours to reach X. If A's speed is 16 km/h, what is B's speed?
problem_hi: दो व्यक्ति A और B, X और Y से एक-दूसरे की ओर चलते हैं। मिलने के बाद, A को Y तक पहुँचने में 9 घंटे लगते हैं और B को X तक पहुँचने में 16 घंटे लगते हैं। यदि A की गति 16 किमी/घंटा है, तो B की गति क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Do log A aur B, X aur Y se ek-doosre ki taraf chalte hain. Meeting ke baad, A ko 9 hours aur B ko 16 hours lagte hain reach karne mein. Agar A ki speed 16 km/h hai, B ki speed kya hai?
problem_hg_065: A and B walk to each other. Meeting ke baad A took 9h and B took 16h to finish. A ki speed B se 20% zyada logic nahi, standard ratio hai. Speed of A is 16 km/h. B ki speed nikalo?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Use formula v1 / v2 = sqrt(t2 / t1).
Final: 12 km/h.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada; LLM may try to apply a 20% rule to the speed of A (16) instead of using the time-ratio square root rule.
why_hard: Requires knowledge of the specific theorem regarding post-meeting times and speeds.
